title: MTH.------TR.
description: Diagram in T(IMP)M-24. The prose above identifies the structural target: 'if the functional properties that outline how given creative thrusts are to be actualized are a necessary factor that relates to the vibrational and cosmic realness of that form, then this necessity must mean something - that is, the functional properties of a given functional creative thrust are as they are because they mean something.' The crossing diagrams how method structurally meets transformation: MTH crossed with TR. MTH sits at upper-center with the subject-arrow; TR at lower-center as partner-axis. VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) upper-left, EXPM (expansionism) upper-right. APL-DT (applied dictates) center, TECH-DY (technological dynamics) center-right, WO-UNF (world unification) right. PER-DY (perceived dynamics) left, MT-INFO (meta-information) center-bottom, PART (participation) right. RT-DY (reality dynamics) lower-center, ACC-FT (accumulated functionalism) lower-right.
